#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date."""
import datetime
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TARGET = "report.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(TARGET):
    print(f"ERROR: {TARGET} not found")
    sys.exit(1)

# 1. Create the cover page PDF with title and current date.
cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 40, "Annual Financial Report")

c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 20, today)

c.save()
print("Cover page written to", cover_path, "with date:", today)

# 2. Merge: cover page first, then all original pages.
reader = PdfReader(TARGET)
cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

tmp_path = "report_with_cover_tmp.pdf"
with open(tmp_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

os.replace(tmp_path, TARGET)
print("Updated", TARGET, "-> now", len(writer.pages), "pages (1 cover +", len(reader.pages), "original)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date.

reportlab is not installed, so the cover page PDF is built by hand as a minimal
valid PDF (Type1 Helvetica fonts) and merged with pypdf.
"""
import datetime
import os
import sys


def build_cover_pdf(title, date_str):
    """Return bytes of a single-page letter-size PDF with centered title and date."""
    def esc(s):
        return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")

    content = (
        "BT /F1 28 Tf 306 436 Td ({}) Tj ET\n"
        "BT /F2 16 Tf 306 376 Td ({}) Tj ET\n"
    ).format(esc(title), esc(date_str)).encode("latin-1")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode("ascii") + b" >>\nstream\n"
        + content + b"endstream",
    ]

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % i).encode("ascii")
        out += obj
        out += b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    n = len(objects) + 1
    out += ("xref\n0 %d\n" % n).encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets[1:]:
        out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % off).encode("ascii")
    out += ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (n, xref_pos)).encode("ascii")
    return bytes(out)


TARGET = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

if not os.path.exists(TARGET):
    print("ERROR: %s not found" % TARGET)
    sys.exit(1)

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter  # noqa: E402

today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print("Cover date:", today)

cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
with open(cover_path, "wb") as f:
    f.write(build_cover_pdf(TITLE, today))
print("Cover page written to", cover_path)

# Validate the hand-built cover parses as a PDF.
cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
assert len(cover_reader.pages) == 1, "cover PDF should have exactly one page"

# Merge: cover first, then all original pages.
reader = PdfReader(TARGET)
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

tmp_path = "report_with_cover_tmp.pdf"
with open(tmp_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
os.replace(tmp_path, TARGET)

# Final validation: page 1 of the updated report contains title and date.
final_reader = PdfReader(TARGET)
first_text = final_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
ok = TITLE in first_text and today in first_text
print("Updated", TARGET, "-> now", len(final_reader.pages),
      "pages (1 cover +", len(reader.pages), "original)")
print("Cover text verified on page 1:", ok)
if not ok:
    sys.exit(2)
